mentions.name: go-llm
mentions.description: A locally-runnable AI assistant that supports voice notes through Telegram and connections to MCP servers, and runs in a single Docker container using less than 100MB of memory. It includes a couple of easter eggs, and planned next steps include direct email and calendar access.
